ownerDecision.text: Take Expat 2.8.5 (CVE-2026-93990, UTF-16 surrogate validation) and OpenSSL 3.6.5 for v0.1.0 and add a UTF-16 regression test; this supersedes the earlier API-scoped acceptance of OpenSSL 3.6.4. Prefer overrides for exactly expat/openssl; if the baseline must move, record every resulting port version change.

whyBaselineMoved: vcpkg resolves versions from the version database of the registry checkout, whose version files must match builtin-baseline. The baseline a1cae005 (2026-09-11) predates Expat 2.8.5 (registry commit 673823e1, 2026-09-23) and OpenSSL 3.6.5 (registry commit e182cb4d, 2026-10-01), so an overrides entry cannot select them without the newer registry; the production gate scripts also require the checkout HEAD to equal builtin-baseline. The earliest registry commit providing both is the OpenSSL 3.6.5 update.

resolvedPortChanges.macosArm64Closure: dry-run of the new manifest on arm64-osx resolves the same eight ports as rc.2 (expat, lz4, openssl, zlib, zstd, vcpkg-cmake, vcpkg-cmake-config, vcpkg-cmake-get-vars); vcpkg-cmake, vcpkg-cmake-config, vcpkg-cmake-get-vars versions are unchanged.

registryBaselineEntriesRelevantToBuildTo.note: not in the macOS closure; Linux and Windows closures are recorded from their gate logs

resolvedPortChanges.vcpkgTool: vcpkg tool release 2026-07-27 -> 2026-09-26 (scripts/vcpkg-tool-metadata.txt of the new baseline); the vcpkg executable is a build tool and is not distributed
resolvedPortChanges.linuxAmd64Closure: Gate log 10-vcpkg-linux-amd64-gate: the same eight ports as macOS (expat 2.8.5, lz4 1.10.0, openssl 3.6.5, zlib 1.3.2#2, zstd 1.5.7, vcpkg-cmake 2025-08-07, vcpkg-cmake-config 2026-07-21, vcpkg-cmake-get-vars 2025-05-29); no pkgconf, vcpkg-make or other port is pulled in.
resolvedPortChanges.windowsClosure: vcpkg resolved eight ports on x64-windows: expat 2.8.5, lz4 1.10.0, openssl 3.6.5, zlib 1.3.2#2, zstd 1.5.7, vcpkg-cmake 2025-08-07, vcpkg-cmake-config 2026-07-21, vcpkg-cmake-get-vars 2025-05-29 (identical to the macOS and Linux closures; vcpkg tool 2026-09-26).

mmxisfUtf16Boundary.headerPreCheck: src/reader.cpp parse_header rejects any header that does not begin with the ASCII bytes <?xml (invalid_xisf), so UTF-16 and BOM-prefixed headers never reach Expat.
mmxisfUtf16Boundary.parser: XML_ParserCreateNS("UTF-8") overrides declared encodings and xml_declaration rejects non-UTF-8 declarations.
mmxisfUtf16Boundary.regressionTests: tests/reader_test.cpp: UTF-16LE with and without BOM, lone high surrogate, high surrogate followed by a non-surrogate, reversed pair (all invalid_xisf); UTF-8-encoded surrogates (malformed_xml); positive control for a well-formed supplementary-plane UTF-8 character.
mmxisfUtf16Boundary.note: These tests guard the boundary on any Expat version; they cannot demonstrate the Expat bug itself because that path is unreachable through mmxisf.

limitations: Linux, macOS and Windows pinned-vcpkg closures are recorded; the final advisory review is docs/security-audits/2026-10-06-rc3-advisory-review.json.
Absence of a published advisory for the other dependencies is a dated observation, not proof of safety.
